en.html:
I needed...
This cursed tsurugi?

For my foster mother's death, I was not looking for somebody else to blame.
Hikaru had put it all too well. A tsurugi was a weapon. Cursed, uncursed, whatever—it was still a tool. The guilt belonged to the person using it.

Kageaki Minato knew perfectly well what a calamity this thing was. Kageaki Minato used it anyway.
For hatred, that one name was sufficient. Mine.
But that did not explain why I had to keep this tsurugi beside me from now on—

ja.text: 景明「……六波羅……」村正《……》景明「そう言っていたな」村正《ええ……》景明「追うぞ」村正《ええ》

en.html:
Two years have passed since then.
We have chased Hikaru ever since—
en.text:
Two years have passed since then.
We have chased Hikaru ever since—

ja.html:
あれから、二年。
　俺達は光を追い――
ja.text:
あれから、二年。
　俺達は光を追い――

en.html:
In place after place, Hikaru left nobody alive.
People began calling her the Silver Star.
en.text:
In place after place, Hikaru left nobody alive.
People began calling her the Silver Star.

ja.html:
光は各地で<ruby>全滅事件<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>を起こし。
　銀星号と呼ばれるようになり。
ja.text:
光は各地で全滅事件・・・・を起こし。
　銀星号と呼ばれるようになり。

en.html:
Sometimes Hikaru and I met.
Sometimes we passed each other by.
en.text:
Sometimes Hikaru and I met.
Sometimes we passed each other by.

ja.html:
時に俺と光は出会い。
　時にすれ違い。
ja.text:
時に俺と光は出会い。
　時にすれ違い。

en.html:
We crushed the "eggs" she scattered.
And killed exactly twice as many people as there were eggs.
en.text:
We crushed the "eggs" she scattered.
And killed exactly twice as many people as there were eggs.

ja.html:
光のばら撒く〝卵〟を潰し。
〝卵〟のちょうど<ruby>倍の数の<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>人間を殺し。
ja.text:
光のばら撒く〝卵〟を潰し。
〝卵〟のちょうど倍の数の・・・・人間を殺し。

en.html:
And still...
we have not stopped Hikaru.
en.text:
And still...
we have not stopped Hikaru.

ja.html:
そうして……
　未だ、光は止められずにいる。
ja.text:
そうして……
　未だ、光は止められずにいる。

en.html:
Kageaki"...Next time. Without fail. No more letting this calamity spread..."
Muramasa《...Yes...》
en.text:
Kageaki"...Next time. Without fail.
No more letting this calamity spread..."Muramasa《...Yes...》

ja.html:
景明「……次こそは必ず。 　これ以上……災厄を広げさせてはならない」
村正《……そうね……》
ja.text:
景明「……次こそは必ず。
　これ以上……災厄を広げさせてはならない」村正《……そうね……》

en.html:
I murmured it like an oath.
The tsurugi knew the hypocrisy. So did I.

I—Muramasa—was the one bringing calamity.
Now, to somebody. One person, somewhere.

For the sin of killing one evil,
I would take on the sin of killing one good.
en.text:
I murmured it like an oath.
The tsurugi knew the hypocrisy. So did I.

I—Muramasa—was the one bringing calamity.
Now, to somebody. One person, somewhere.

For the sin of killing one evil,
I would take on the sin of killing one good.

ja.html:
誓うように呟いて。
　俺も劒冑も、その偽善を知っていた。

　<ruby>村正<rt>おれ</rt></ruby>こそが災厄をもたらすのだ。
　これから――何処かの、一人の人間に。

　一つの悪を殺した罪に懸けて。
　一つの善を殺す罪を負う。

Muramasa《Yes...》

en.html:
I am Muramasa.
I am a warrior of calamity.
en.text:
I am Muramasa.
I am a warrior of calamity.

ja.html:
俺は村正。
　<ruby>災禍<rt>わざわい</rt></ruby>の武者である。
ja.text:
